model_weights: Same frozen natural10k checkpoint for all policies; zero optimizer updates
stage: Limited official VAL repair-direction acceptance; not whole-VAL or paper-final certification
predeclaration_scope: Known branch diagnostic already motivated these two policies. The new12 confirmation identities were chosen by identity order, not outcomes. New repair dev and confirmation predictions must not determine thresholds.
required_pairing: Same selected group/mode/member/sequence/start/source_first, original case_seed, observation/reference input SHA256 and frames for all policies.
Same frozen checkpoint SHA256, DDIM20 and numerical runtime; analytical physics remains disabled.
Reference comparison is reporting only. No GT/reference error may select a per-window output or enter inference routing.
Compute every predeclared window and both regimes; incomplete panels cannot pass. Hidden-empty windows are excluded from hidden means only and their count is reported.

aggregation.window_metric: Use the existing FK-based hidden/visible MPJPE, GT-low-speed-foot speed, MPJVE and acceleration definitions.
aggregation.group: Within each panel, dataset and regime: arithmetic mean of valid window means; preserve window P90 and valid count.
aggregation.regime_macro: PRIMARY: natural-size weighted rich/trumans/egobody dataset hidden means using natural_dataset_weights. SECONDARY: equal-dataset macro, reported without selecting policies.
aggregation.combined_macro: PRIMARY: equal clean/noisy average of natural-size weighted regime means. SECONDARY: equal clean/noisy/equal-dataset six-group macro.
aggregation.paired: Report candidate-minus-original per window and group, and reference comparison for every window.
aggregation.natural_weights_source: Original SELECTION.source_manifest natural_dataset_weights; source file sha256 bound by SELECTION.

shared_panel_guards.catastrophic_new_vs_original: No window-regime hidden error may worsen by50mm or more against original.
shared_panel_guards.catastrophic_vs_reference: Count of window-regime hidden error >= reference+50mm must not increase versus original, checked separately for clean/noisy.
shared_panel_guards.hidden_p90: Report window-mean P90 per dataset/regime and paired change. Four windows per group is too small for a stable tail claim; no independent P90-based candidate tuning.
shared_panel_guards.clean_and_noisy_macro: Each regime PRIMARY natural-size weighted hidden mean must not exceed original; equal-dataset macro is reported separately.
shared_panel_guards.combined_hidden_gain: PRIMARY combined clean/noisy natural-size weighted hidden mean must improve by at least3% relative to original.

ego_guards.check: Every candidate EGO prediction must be bitwise array_equal to original for the same anchor/regime; input/reference hash equality also required.
ego_guards.failure: Any EGO mismatch fails the policy; a tolerance-based replacement is not permitted.

dev.eligible: All shared_panel_guards, ego_guards and known_yoga checks must pass.
dev.choice: Among eligible policies choose smallest dev PRIMARY combined natural-size weighted hidden mean. If difference is <1mm, choose simpler exo_patch_off. If none is eligible, declare NO and do not use confirmation to rescue or switch policy.
dev.freeze: Before reading candidate confirmation metrics, write a dated immutable DEV_CHOICE with dev evidence and chosen policy, or NO. Prefer run all policies dev first, then selected confirmation.

confirmation.decision: Apply the same shared_panel_guards to the one frozen DEV_CHOICE policy; confirmation is pass/fail only.
confirmation.prohibited: Do not select the runner-up, mix policies per window, change thresholds, or tune coefficients using confirmation results.
confirmation.on_failure: Keep repair unaccepted and formal metrics paused; report exact failing dataset/regime/window instead of promoting the other candidate.
confirmation.disclosure: The rotating10000 identities were monitored historically. This recording-disjoint confirmation is not a blind holdout or TEST.

after_pass: Keep the winning policy fixed, then run paired sceneOFF for24 EXO windows x2 regimes=48 predictions. This scene ablation does not reselect the repair policy.
required_reporting: Dev/confirmation separate, all three datasets separate, clean/noisy separate; paired macro and group changes.
Hidden mean/P90, visible error, foot speed, acceleration, MPJVE, reference hidden mean and severe counts.
Known yoga result plus every new >=50mm regression, not just average gains.
EGO6 exact checks, checkpoint/selection/input identities, completed prediction counts and independent CPU FK recheck.
No claim that this54-prediction-per-policy diagnostic is the full100-window panel or final paper metric.

pre_evaluation_revision.reason: Root clarified primary selection must use original natural-size dataset weights. This revision precedes PLAN and repair predictions.
